Question: Eric plans to compete in a triathlon. He can average \(2\) miles per hour in the \(\tfrac14\)-mile swim and \(6\) miles per hour in the \(3\)-mile run. His goal is to finish the triathlon in \(2\) hours. To accomplish his goal what must his average speed, in miles per hour, be for the \(15\)-mile bicycle ride?
